mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS definitionId,CAST(v.id AS CHAR) AS versionId,v.definition_json AS definition,f.flow_key AS flowKey,v.version_no AS versionNo FROM fcc_flow_definition f JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id=f.id
WHERE v.id=#{version}
WHERE f.flow_key=CONCAT('SYSTEM_',#{template}) AND v.publish_status='PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT current_step_key AS step,status,context_json AS context FROM fcc_flow_instance WHERE id=#{call} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_flow_step_execution SET status=#{previousStatus},ended_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),duration_ms=GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000),output_json=#{output} WHERE flow_instance_id=#{call} AND ended_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_flow_step_execution(id,flow_instance_id,call_id,stage,step_key,action_type,attempt_no,trigger_event_id,status,input_json,started_at,ended_at,duration_ms) SELECT #{id},#{call},#{call},#{step},#{step},#{step},COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no),0)+1,#{event},#{status},#{input},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),CASE WHEN #{step}='END' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) END,CASE WHEN #{step}='END' THEN 0 END FROM fcc_flow_step_execution WHERE flow_instance_id=#{call} AND step_key=#{step}
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_flow_instance SET current_step_key=#{step},status=CASE WHEN #{step}='END' THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END,ended_at=CASE WHEN #{step}='END' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) END,context_json=JSON_SET(context_json,'$.executionToken',#{token}),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{call}
